item: N12(vi) content review -- mechanical pre-screen (block lines 72-85)

scope.content_source: git objects via git cat-file --batch (committed bytes; working tree not read)
scope.untracked_note: untracked HANDOFF-*.md files in the working tree are not in any commit, so not in the release unless committed later; listed by name only, not read

history_only.version_rule: for each commit deleting the path (--no-renames): the blob at that commit's first parent

method.line_split: on \n; 'lines' = number of \n-separated lines (a trailing newline does not add a line)
method.excerpt: <= 40 chars of the line after masking every [SCRATCH_PATH] [MACOS_TEMP_PATH] [LOCAL_HOME_PATH] [CLAUDE_AI_URL] [TRANSCRIPT_ID] (round 10: a whole path token, see excerpt_path_classes) [EMAIL] [PHONE] [ADDR] [IP] [CRED] [ID] [TOK] (alnum/_-+= run >= 20 with a letter and a digit) [NAME] (given-name list word or given-name pair) [W] (one to three words after Dear/Hi/Hello/From:/To:/Cc:/Subject:/Regards/Best,/Cheers,/Thanks, or before wrote:) span, and [ID_FLAG] (round 10, release: an identity-file flag with its argument, on a line naming ssh); window starts 10 chars before the hit, or at the hit's own token (see excerpt_release_rules); a cut part of a token at either end of the window is replaced by [CUT] unless it is a plain word, and at the right end a cut run of joined tokens up to its last reference-shaped token
method.excerpt_path_classes: round 10 (2026-10-12), excerpts only: a token holding a local scratch-path anchor (a path under the tmp directory, the per-uid scratch directory name, the per-user project-slug form) is masked whole as [SCRATCH_PATH]; a macOS per-user temp path under the folders directory as [MACOS_TEMP_PATH]; a local home-directory path as [LOCAL_HOME_PATH] (added because masking the longer scratch paths brought two home-directory paths into a 40-char window); a claude.ai session URL with its tail as [CLAUDE_AI_URL]; a uuid-shaped id as [TRANSCRIPT_ID]. The token is extended both ways to whitespace or a quote, backtick, bracket, brace, angle bracket, backslash, pipe, comma or semicolon; trailing '.' and ':' stay as punctuation. Where classes overlap, the order is SCRATCH_PATH, MACOS_TEMP_PATH, LOCAL_HOME_PATH, CLAUDE_AI_URL, TRANSCRIPT_ID, then the other placeholders. Counts, verdicts, categories, locators and redacted values do not read excerpts and are unchanged by it
method.excerpt_release_rules: round 10, release (2026-10-12), excerpts only, so that this JSON, screened in its turn by the history and licenses scans once committed, adds no value they read as new: (a) on a line that names ssh in any case, the identity-file flag (dash i, either case, at the line start or after whitespace) is masked together with its argument as one [ID_FLAG] span, which absorbs any placeholder inside it; (b) a token is a run of characters other than whitespace, a quote, backtick, bracket, brace, angle bracket, backslash, pipe, comma or semicolon; where the 40-char window cuts a token at either end (not inside a placeholder), the cut part is replaced by [CUT] unless it is ASCII letters only and the whole token has no reference shape (a scheme separator, a www label, a dotted name ending in two letters, a slash next to a name character, an at sign); where the hit lies in the token cut at the left and starts within 30 chars of that token, the window starts at the token instead, so the hit stays visible where its token fits the window; where the right end cuts a run (characters other than whitespace, a quote, a backtick, a closing parenthesis or a closing bracket, so tokens joined by angle brackets, braces, opening parentheses or brackets, backslashes, pipes, commas or semicolons), the run's part in the window from its start, or the window's, to the end of its last token with a reference shape is replaced by [CUT] as well; so no excerpt starts or ends inside a token with a host, URL, path or id shape, and none ends inside such a joined run (one can start inside a joined run's later token); an excerpt can exceed the window by at most the placeholder's length at each end; (c) non-printable characters are mapped to spaces before masking, not after the cut. Counts, verdicts, categories, locators, redacted values and the leak guard do not read excerpts and are unchanged by it
method.redacted_form: first 4 chars + '...' + length + ':' + first 8 hex of sha256(value, utf-8)
method.email_allowlist: two addresses (the author's own; Anthropic's noreply) counted under email_allowlisted_counts, never listed as hits
method.private_context: confidentiality/private hits immediately preceded by '/' are tagged context=path (e.g. a /private/tmp path); reported, not discounted
method.multiword_line_break: multi-word phrases (do not share, not for publication, internal only, off the record, my wife/husband/partner/kid, Sent from) are also matched across a line end and tagged spans_next_line
method.names: tier_a: capitalised word pairs, neither word in the name allowlist (counts only); tier_b: tier_a pairs whose first word is in the embedded given-name list (381 names; counts and line numbers only, never the names)
method.generic_high_entropy: alnum run >= 24 with a letter and a digit, not pure hex, Shannon entropy >= 3.5 bits/char; pure-hex runs >= 24 (hashes, shas) are skipped and only counted
method.infra_identifier: supplementary category (RunPod proxy hosts / ssh users, labelled pod/volume/endpoint ids containing a digit, RUNPOD_* env values, ~/.ssh key file names, ssh -i arguments); masked in every excerpt
method.url_hosts: host labels that look like ids (>= 8 chars with letter+digit, >= 16 chars, or <alnum>-<port>) and IP hosts are redacted
method.limitations: regex heuristics only: no semantic reading; phone/address/name shapes are English-language/US/AU-centric; a sensitive span matching no pattern is not masked; correspondence markers are case-sensitive

identities.signature_note: signature blocks are not parsed; an SSH signature embeds the signer's public key, which is published with the commit
